utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is wrong with your car that you need the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... what's it for again?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: You mentioned needing a repair drive for your car, but now you're asking what it's for? Which is it?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I've been picking up bits and pieces about it. What kind of stuff are you planning to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm still not sure what the repair drive actually is—can you explain it to me first before we talk about what to bring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, it's a community thing where neighbors bring broken items—like toasters or chairs—and volunteers help fix them up for free. Happens this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, that's why I'm asking. We should have a clear plan B in case the drive fails or takes too long.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you really certain it's even happening? I still haven't seen a flyer or a post about it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a fair point—without any official notice, I'm starting to wonder if we're all just running on hearsay and no real schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Dane, that gray van with the dented side panel turned onto Maple Street about twenty minutes ago—could be the repair drive, but I haven't seen any official notice either.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, a gray van? I didn't see any notice posted either. Maybe it's just someone visiting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could be, but the timing fits with what I'd expect for a repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I saw Opal mention a gray van with a dented panel on Maple Street, so maybe it's already started—can you confirm?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm not sure about a van yet, Faye. I prefer to stick to the plan—Saturday's the day we agreed on, so I'll wait for that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Alright, I'll plan for Saturday then. Thanks for keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, just to clarify, the repair drive is for electronics and small appliances, not cars!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Jules! That makes sense. Let me know if you need any help sorting or hauling stuff.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's really kind of you, Sam! I'd love the help — maybe you could take charge of the sign-in table?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's this Saturday, Noah! The fix-it drive at the community center — bring anything that needs mending!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: This Saturday? Hmm, I think I've got something else going on, but I'll try to remember.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Well, if you can make it, it'll be great — we've got tools and coffee, and everyone's chipping in!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, the repair drive. What's the time again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday, 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, 10 AM on Saturday. I'll try to swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Cleo, I know the date change threw you off—maybe Uli here can help us sort things out once you've checked your calendar.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: You're right, Rosa—I've got my calendar here. Let me double-check if I can make Sunday work instead.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Take your time, Cleo—we'll figure it out together once you're sure.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, have you heard about the repair drive at the community center? They're taking in broken appliances and furniture to fix up!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's the repair drive I've been trying to schedule! Still figuring out a date—Noah mentioned the 14th might not work for him.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, gotcha! So it's still in the planning stages—well, if you need a hand spreading the word or hauling stuff, you know I'm always up for a good neighborhood project.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You know, I've been telling everyone to come early on Saturday from 9 to 3—bring anything that needs fixing!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday from 9 to 3? Alright, I'll see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Uli! I've been telling everyone to come early—the more the merrier! See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Ira, I'm curious about the repair drive—what's it actually for?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm still trying to figure that out myself—haven't seen any official notice, but Cleo said it's this Saturday. You know anything more?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I only know that Cleo mentioned it's this Saturday and they need spare parts and tools. Vik asked what I needed, so maybe they're gathering resources.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Ira, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? They're taking in broken appliances and furniture to fix up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh yeah, I think Cleo mentioned that. Sounds like a good way to help out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It really is! I'm planning to bring in my old toaster that's been on the fritz—maybe they can work some magic on it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's a community effort to fix up the old playground equipment. We're meeting at the park Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh—so that gray van with the dented panel I saw on Maple... they must be hauling tools for the playground. I'll keep an eye on where they park.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That van... I hope it's not causing any trouble. We just need the tools to arrive safely.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Eli, just a heads-up—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, Sunday? I was set for Saturday. Are you sure about the change?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I'm sure — we had to shift it to Sunday due to some scheduling conflicts at the front porch. Sorry for the last-minute change!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, so it's a real thing then? I keep hearing different bits about it—someone said it was at the community center, and now you're saying it's for Mrs. Gable's fence.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, it's real — we're fixing up things like Mrs. Gable's fence. Still trying to pin down a date, though. Noah's iffy on the 14th.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: So it's not for sure Saturday then? I heard from a few folks it was this Saturday, but maybe they were confused.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, Saturday the 14th — no time yet. I'll check later and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Okay, sounds good — just let me know when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do, catch you later.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The repair drive? I'm trying to remember what that's about. Did you know?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you bet I know! It's this Saturday — we're fixing up the community center, patching potholes on Elm Street, and doing a general sprucing up around the neighborhood. Everyone's invited!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, the community center! I knew it was something important. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Gus! The repair drive is this Saturday — do you have any spare parts or tools we could use?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Actually Cleo, I just heard from Rosa that it's been moved to Sunday at the community center. I've got plenty of tools ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Gus! I'll update my list. Glad you've got tools ready!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey, I'm glad you asked — I was just talking with Gus about helping out with that. I think we're getting folks together to fix up old stuff for the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. I've been trying to figure out what we're supposed to bring or do—are there tools needed?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I think Gus mentioned we could use a mix of tools — screwdrivers, maybe some wrenches. I'm planning to bring my old toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Leo, are you sure about the repair drive date? I keep hearing different things.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not sure, Faye. Check with Tess.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Alright, I'll try Tess. It's just tough to plan with all these mixed signals.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Hana, just wanted to remind you—the repair drive is this Saturday from 9 to 3, and I've been telling everyone to come early with whatever needs fixing!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hold on, Vik—you're talking about a community repair event? Is it the same as that USB stick Noah mentioned, or are we mixing two things up?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, no, no—this is just the repair drive, not about any USB stick. It's this Saturday, 9 to 3, bring anything that needs fixing!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. Yeah, I keep forgetting which one's which. Did someone actually put up flyers for it, or is it just talk?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I haven't seen any flyers or official notice. Are you sure this repair drive is actually happening?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Now you've got me second-guessing too. I could swear I heard something about it at the corner store, but maybe that was just the potluck planning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait—you've got a car AND gadgets needing fixing? Which one's the real problem?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No, no—the repair drive is just for electronics, not cars. I don't have a car problem, just some old gadgets I'm hoping to get fixed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, so what gadgets are you bringing? I might have a few old things too.
